visible_text: Ken Windows は次の周で追います。
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
オンボーディングを試作する
この会議について聞く
AI が見ている資料 ー まだありません

answers.q1: An app is recording and live-transcribing a meeting ('02:38 の会議'). While recording is running, an AI assistant is pulling out a transcript, memo items, and (still empty) decisions/to-dos from what the two speakers, Ken and Sarah, are saying.
answers.q2: The warning '音が届いていません' (no audio is coming in) stands out most, because it directly contradicts the '録音中' (recording) status right next to it — if true, nothing being captured right now is actually being transcribed, which threatens the whole point of the screen.
answers.q3: I can switch between 文字起こし/翻訳/字幕 tabs on the right, expand the two memo entries with the chevron to see more detail, click '出所' to check where a memo came from, type a question into 'この会議について聞く' at the bottom, or tap リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション to get a summary or drill into decisions and action items.
answers.q4: Not fully. The one memo that overlaps with the transcript (Ken, macOS を先に出します at 10:42) matches, which is a small positive signal, but both 決まったこと and やること are still empty placeholders so there is nothing yet to verify there, and the 'AI が見ている資料 ー まだありません' line plus the conflicting '音が届いていません' warning make it hard to trust that capture is even working right now. I could check accuracy by opening 出所 on each memo and comparing it to the live transcript, but the screen doesn't make that check easy or obviously encouraged.
answers.q5: The dark floating toolbar pill at the very top feels like a second, disconnected control surface competing with the page's own '録音中' status line below it. The 翻訳 and 字幕 tabs are unclear value for what looks like a single-language meeting. The italic 'を待っています…' filler text in the empty 決まったこと/やること sections adds words without adding information.
answers.q6: The dark floating toolbar pill at the top-center, because its black fill and rounded shape contrast hardest against the light gray page — after that, the eye drops to the red 録音中 dot and the bold '02:38 の会議' heading.

weaknesses.what: '録音中' (recording) and '音が届いていません' (no audio reaching it) sit right next to each other and contradict each other, with no explanation of which is true or what to do about it.
weaknesses.fix: Resolve the conflicting states into one clear status (e.g. 'recording but no sound detected — check your mic') instead of showing both a green-light label and a red-flag warning at once.

weaknesses.what: Empty 決まったこと and やること sections just repeat 'を待っています…', which reads as generic filler rather than useful information at first glance.
weaknesses.fix: Replace with a lighter, more specific empty state (e.g. hide the section until the first item lands, or show a one-line hint of what will appear there).

weaknesses.what: The floating black toolbar pill at the top is visually the loudest element on the screen but is functionally separate from the meeting panel beneath it, splitting attention before the user even reads the meeting content.
weaknesses.fix: Reduce the toolbar's visual weight (lighter fill or smaller footprint) or dock it into the same surface as the '録音中' status so they read as one control, not two.
